bugs.name: Dashboard menu actions reload the page
bugs.summary: Choosing Move, Duplicate or Move to trash from a dashboard's menu reloads the whole page, so dashboard state such as the selected tab is lost and resets to the first tab, including after cancelling the dialog
bugs.expected: The action opens its modal in place, without a full page reload, and the dashboard keeps its state.
bugs.actual: These menu items now render as plain links, so the browser does a full page reload before the modal opens. The reload drops dashboard state: the selected tab resets to the first tab, and it stays there after the Move or Duplicate dialog is cancelled.
reproSteps: Create and save a dashboard with at least two tabs, and select a tab other than the first one.
Open the dashboard's ... menu and choose Move, Duplicate or Move to trash.
Watch whether the browser reloads the page before the modal appears, and whether the first tab is selected after cancelling.
